svg.title: GNSS signal availability on a shell above the constellations
svg.desc: Signal availability for a user on a sphere at 36000 km altitude with a hemisphere antenna, from a real run of engine v0.40.0 on scenarios/gnss-ssv-shell.toml (a reduced run: 162 users, 3 days, 10 min steps), at a 20 dB-Hz threshold. For each constellation and band, two bars: the share of (user, epoch) pairs with at least one signal and with at least four. Combined, L1: 99.4 % at least one, 73.2 % at least four, longest outage below four signals 160 min. Combined, L5: 100.0 % at least one, 99.9 % at least four, longest outage below four signals 20 min. MODELLED: a modelled study from stated inputs, not a measurement and not a service-volume claim for any system. The reduced size is not the booklet comparison. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
